title: ZeroTier
summary: Join ZeroTier networks on the Cardputer Zero: node, IP and status.
description:
ZeroTier client for the Cardputer Zero. See every network you have joined, whether it is up, and the IP this node got, then switch networks without a laptop.

Features
- Node online state and 10 character node ID in the top bar
- One card per network: name, state (OK / OFF / REQ), assigned IP and network ID
- ENTER connects the selected network, D disconnects it after a confirmation, N joins a new network by typing its 16 digit ID
- Disconnecting keeps the network in the list, so reconnecting later is one key press and no ID retyping
- 16 cell progress meter while typing a network ID
- Hold ESC for 3 seconds to leave the app, release to cancel
- Runs as a normal user; the only privileged command is zerotier-cli

One time setup (the app shows a hint until this is done)
1) sudo apt install zerotier-one    (then join your network on the PC side or from this app)
2) echo 'ALL ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /usr/sbin/zerotier-cli' | sudo tee /etc/sudoers.d/cardputer-zerotier
   sudo chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/cardputer-zerotier

Permissions: network only. No camera, microphone, IMU, extra hardware, background service or external display.
